phrases.en: I'm gonna grab a coffee. Want anything?
phrases.zh: 我去买杯咖啡，你要带点什么吗？
phrases.focus: gonna = going to，口语里几乎必缩
variants: I'm grabbing a coffee — want one?
phrases.avoid: I am going to buy a cup of coffee. Do you want anything?
phrases.context: 办公室午后，随口问同事要不要带咖啡

phrases.en: Could I get that to go?
phrases.focus: to go = 外带，比 take away 更美式

notes: get that 的 t 只做口型不爆破

variants: Can I get this to go?
phrases.context: 咖啡店点完单，店员问堂食还是外带

phrases.en: I'll have the same.
phrases.focus: I'll have = 点单最常用句式，比 I want 礼貌
phrases.context: 朋友先点了，你懒得选，直接跟一份

phrases.en: Can I get a refill?
phrases.focus: refill 是美式餐厅的免费续杯，进店必会
phrases.avoid: Can I add one more cup for free?
phrases.transfer: Can I get a refill of ___?
phrases.context: 美式餐厅服务员路过，你杯子空了

phrases.en: I'm just looking, thanks.
phrases.focus: 店员一靠近就用这句，礼貌拒绝不尴尬

notes: looking 的 ing 读 /ɪŋ/，不要读成 /ɪn/

phrases.context: 进店后店员问 Can I help you?

phrases.en: For here or to go?
phrases.focus: 店员问你时的原话，听懂就能立刻回答
phrases.context: 点完单，收银员抬头问你

phrases.en: To go, please.
phrases.focus: 最短回答，两个词解决问题
phrases.context: 回答 For here or to go?

phrases.en: I'll take the combo.
phrases.focus: combo = 套餐，快餐店高频词
variants: I'll do the number two combo.
phrases.context: 快餐店菜单上写着 Combo 1/2/3

phrases.en: Can I swap the fries for a salad?
phrases.focus: swap A for B = 把 A 换成 B，办事万能句式

pronunciation.ipa: /kən aɪ swɑp ðə fraɪz fər ə ˈsæləd/
notes: swap 的 p 只做口型

variants: Could I get a salad instead of fries?
phrases.avoid: Can I change french fries to salad?
phrases.context: 套餐默认配薯条，你想吃轻一点

phrases.en: That's it, thanks.
phrases.focus: 点完单收尾的固定说法，比 No more 自然

phrases.en: What's good here?
phrases.focus: 问招牌的最地道问法，比 recommend 更随口
phrases.context: 第一次进这家店，看服务员有空

phrases.en: I'll do the burger, medium.
phrases.focus: I'll do = 我要，比 I'll have 更随意干练
variants: I'll go with the burger, medium.
phrases.context: 服务员记单，问你汉堡要几分熟

phrases.en: Does that come with fries?
phrases.focus: come with = 附带，点单看菜单必用

notes: fries 的 z 音别读成 s

phrases.context: 菜单只写了主菜，你想确认配菜

phrases.en: Could we get a menu?
phrases.focus: 进店坐下第一句，Could we 比 Can I 更客气
phrases.context: 坐下后服务员还没递菜单

phrases.en: I'm starving — let's order a bunch.
phrases.focus: starving 比 hungry 情绪强，日常口语首选
phrases.avoid: I am very hunger, let us order more.

phrases.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.
phrases.focus: allergic to 是固定搭配，救命句必须背熟
phrases.context: 点菜前主动告知，避免出事

phrases.en: No onions, please.
phrases.focus: 最短忌口表达，直接加 please 就礼貌

notes: 别加 s 音到 please 前

phrases.en: Can I get that without cheese?
phrases.focus: without 是最稳的忌口句式，任何菜都能套
variants: Could I get it without cheese?
phrases.context: 菜单写着 cheeseburger，你不吃芝士

phrases.en: Is this spicy?
phrases.focus: 三个词的必问句，辣度不合会毁一顿饭

notes: spicy 的 sp 别加音 /ˈspaɪsi/

phrases.context: 点了不熟悉的菜，先问辣不辣

phrases.en: I'll pass on the sauce.
phrases.focus: pass on = 不要了，比 no 更委婉有分寸
phrases.context: 服务员问要不要加特制酱

phrases.en: What do you recommend?
phrases.focus: 万能问推荐句，餐厅、理发、买车都能用
phrases.avoid: What do you suggest me to eat?
phrases.context: 菜单太多看不懂，直接问服务员

phrases.en: What's your most popular dish?
phrases.focus: 问招牌菜，比 best seller 更自然
phrases.avoid: What is your most fire dish?

phrases.en: Is this any good?
phrases.focus: any good = 好不好，最轻的口语问法
phrases.context: 指着菜单上某道菜问服务员

phrases.en: Never had this — what's in it?
phrases.focus: 省略主语的随口语序，真实对话就是这个节奏

notes: what's in it 连成一串 /wʌtsɪnɪt/

variants: I've never had this. What's in it?
phrases.avoid: I never eat this, inside have what?
phrases.context: 看到不认识的菜名直接问

phrases.en: I'll trust you on this one.
phrases.focus: 把选择权交出去，比 I don't know 更从容

notes: on this 的 n 转音 /ɑnðɪs/

phrases.context: 服务员列了三样，你不想纠结

phrases.en: Can I get an iced americano?
phrases.focus: 美式咖啡的固定说法，直接说 americano

notes: americano 重音在倒数第二音节

variants: Could I get a large iced americano?

phrases.en: Make it a large, please.
phrases.focus: make it = 改成，点单时可以连续追加要求

phrases.en: Easy on the ice.
phrases.focus: easy on = 少放点，比 less ice 更地道

phrases.en: Could I get that with oat milk?
phrases.focus: with + 奶类，是美国咖啡店的标准换奶说法

pronunciation.ipa: /kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ðæt wɪð oʊt mɪlk/
notes: milk 的 l 要含糊到位

variants: Can you make it with oat milk?
phrases.avoid: Can I change to oat milk?
phrases.context: 乳糖不耐，点拿铁时换奶

phrases.en: Just water for me, thanks.
phrases.focus: for me = 给我的，集体点单时最省事

notes: water 的美音 /ˈwɔtər/，t 变闪音

phrases.avoid: I only drink water, no other.
phrases.context: 服务员挨个问喝什么，轮到你

phrases.en: What's the soup of the day?
phrases.focus: soup of the day = 每日例汤，坐下先问
variants: What soup do you have today?

phrases.en: Can I get extra napkins?
phrases.focus: extra + 名词 = 多来点，万能加量句式

notes: napkins 结尾是 z 音

variants: Could I get some extra napkins?

phrases.en: Could we split the bill?
phrases.focus: split the bill = 分摊账单，聚餐高频

notes: split 的 t 只做口型

phrases.en: I'm good, just the check.
phrases.focus: I'm good = 够了不要了，比 No 礼貌
variants: I'm all set, just the check.
phrases.avoid: I don't want, give me bill.

phrases.en: Do you take Apple Pay?
phrases.zh: 你们收 Apple Pay 吗？
phrases.focus: take + 支付方式 = 收不收，购物必问
variants: Can I pay with Apple Pay?

phrases.en: Are you open?
phrases.focus: 三个词确认营业，避免白跑

phrases.en: Where's the fitting room?
phrases.focus: fitting room = 试衣间，进店必找
phrases.context: 拿着衣服找不到试衣间

phrases.en: I'm looking for a jacket.
phrases.focus: be looking for = 我在找，店员最常听到的句子

phrases.en: Is this on sale?
phrases.focus: on sale = 打折，for sale 才是出售

phrases.en: Do you have this in my size?
phrases.focus: in my size = 我的尺码，试穿必备

pronunciation.ipa: /du ju hæv ðɪs ɪn maɪ saɪz/

phrases.en: How much is this?
phrases.focus: 最基础的问价句，任何场合都能用

phrases.en: That's a bit steep.
phrases.focus: steep 形容价格高，比 expensive 口语
phrases.avoid: That is too expensive for me.

phrases.en: Any discount if I buy two?
phrases.focus: Any discount = 有折扣吗，还价开场
variants: Could I get a deal for two?

phrases.en: Is tax included?
phrases.focus: 美国标价常不含税，必须问

phrases.en: It's out of my budget.
phrases.focus: out of my budget = 超预算，礼貌拒绝
phrases.avoid: I have no money for this.

phrases.en: Can I try this on?
phrases.focus: try on = 试穿，代词要放中间 try it on

phrases.en: It's too tight around the waist.
phrases.focus: around the waist = 腰部一圈，描述版型

phrases.en: Do you have a bigger size?
phrases.focus: bigger size = 大一码，试穿必说

notes: bigger 的 g 只发一个

variants: Could I get one size up?

phrases.en: How does this look on me?
phrases.focus: look on me = 穿我身上，问朋友意见

phrases.en: I'll think about it.
phrases.focus: 逛店的优雅退出句，不用解释

phrases.en: I'm a medium in this brand.
phrases.focus: in this brand = 在这个牌子，说明尺码习惯

phrases.en: Do you have it in black?
phrases.focus: in + 颜色，问颜色最简说法
variants: Any chance you have it in black?

phrases.en: This runs small.
phrases.focus: runs small / runs big 是尺码固定说法
phrases.avoid: This size is small than normal.

phrases.en: Do you carry petites?
phrases.focus: carry = 有卖，比 have 更店铺化
variants: Do you have a petites section?
phrases.avoid: Do you sell small size for short?
phrases.context: 个子小找不到合适尺码

phrases.en: I'll take it in navy.
phrases.focus: take it in + 颜色 = 就要这个颜色

phrases.en: Card or cash?
phrases.focus: 收银员问你，听懂就能秒回
variants: How would you like to pay?

phrases.en: I'll pay by card.
phrases.focus: pay by + 方式，最稳回答

phrases.en: Can I tap?
phrases.focus: tap = 闪付，美国结账超常用

notes: tap 的 p 只做口型

phrases.en: Could I get a receipt?
phrases.focus: receipt 的 p 不发音，重点词

phrases.en: Keep the change.
Could I get a bag?
phrases.focus: Could I get = 能给我，购物高频

phrases.en: No bag, thanks.
Can you email me the receipt?
phrases.focus: email me + 东西 = 发我，办事常用
variants: Could you send it to my email?
phrases.avoid: Can you send receipt to email?

phrases.en: I need a gift receipt.
phrases.focus: gift receipt = 可退换的礼品凭证
variants: Could I get a gift receipt?
phrases.avoid: I need the receipt for present.

phrases.en: Where's the pickup counter?
phrases.focus: pickup counter = 网上下单取货处
variants: Where do I pick up my order?

phrases.en: I'll take this one.
phrases.focus: take this one = 就这个，决定购买

phrases.en: Can I return it if it doesn't fit?
phrases.focus: if it doesn't fit = 如果不合身，退货先问清

pronunciation.ipa: /kən aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ɪt ɪf ɪt ˈdʌzənt fɪt/

phrases.avoid: Can I give back if not fit?

phrases.en: What's your return policy?
phrases.focus: return policy = 退货政策，购物必知
variants: How does your return policy work?
phrases.avoid: What is your rule for return?

phrases.en: Do you price match?
phrases.focus: price match = 匹配别家更低价
variants: Can you match the online price?
phrases.avoid: Do you same price with others?

phrases.en: I'm just browsing, thanks.
phrases.focus: browsing = 随便逛，试穿后不想买

phrases.en: Extra sauce on the side, please.
phrases.focus: on the side = 单独放，点单精准表达

phrases.en: Easy on the mayo.
phrases.focus: easy on = 少放，比 less 更口语

phrases.en: Can I add avocado?
phrases.focus: add + 配料 = 加料，加钱也这么说
variants: Could I add avocado to that?

phrases.en: Hold the pickles.
phrases.focus: hold = 去掉，快餐店最地道说法

phrases.en: Make it spicy.
phrases.focus: make it + 形容词 = 做成什么样

notes: spicy 的 sp 不加音

phrases.en: I'll take a latte, no foam.
phrases.focus: no foam = 不要奶泡，咖啡店精准点单

phrases.en: Can you make it extra hot?
phrases.focus: extra hot = 更热，热饮常用

phrases.en: One refill, please.
phrases.focus: refill 名词直接用，最简续杯

phrases.en: Is the drip coffee bottomless?
phrases.focus: bottomless = 无限续杯，美式餐厅特色
variants: Does the drip come with free refills?

phrases.en: Could I get a cup of water?
phrases.focus: a cup of water，任何店都能要

pronunciation.ipa: /kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ə kʌp əv ˈwɔtər/

phrases.transfer: Could I get a cup of ___?

phrases.en: Check, please.
phrases.focus: 两个词结账，美国餐厅最常用

phrases.en: We're splitting it three ways.
phrases.focus: split + 份数，说明怎么分账

phrases.en: Can we get separate checks?
phrases.focus: separate checks = 各自买单，聚餐必问

phrases.en: Do you take tips on card?
phrases.focus: tips on card = 刷卡付小费
variants: Can I tip with a card?

phrases.en: I think there's a mistake on the bill.
phrases.focus: there's a mistake = 有个错，礼貌指出

pronunciation.ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk ðɛrz ə mɪˈsteɪk ɑn ðə bɪl/

phrases.transfer: I think there's a mistake on ___.

phrases.en: I'll take a number three, no pickles.
phrases.zh: 我要三号套餐，不要酸黄瓜。
phrases.focus: 免下车点单句式：编号 + 去料

pronunciation.ipa: /aɪl teɪk ə ˈnʌmbər θri noʊ ˈpɪkəlz/

phrases.avoid: I want third set no cucumber.

phrases.en: Can I get a side of ranch?
phrases.focus: a side of = 一份配酱，快餐高频

pronunciation.ipa: /kən aɪ ɡɛt ə saɪd əv ræntʃ/

variants: Could I get some ranch on the side?
phrases.transfer: Can I get a side of ___?

phrases.en: Is the machine working?
phrases.focus: 点单机坏了时的实用句
phrases.avoid: Is the machine broken or not?

phrases.en: That's everything, thanks.
phrases.focus: 点单收尾，比 That's all 更完整

phrases.en: I'll pull up to the window.
phrases.focus: pull up = 把车开到，免下车场景必听
phrases.context: 点完单被指引到取餐口

phrases.en: Could you heat this up?
phrases.focus: heat up = 加热，带走剩菜必用
phrases.avoid: Can you make it hot again?

phrases.en: Can I get a box for this?
phrases.focus: box = 打包盒，比 container 更口语

pronunciation.ipa: /kən aɪ ɡɛt ə bɑks fər ðɪs/

variants: Could I get a to-go box?
phrases.avoid: Give me a bag for this.
phrases.transfer: Can I get a box for ___?

phrases.en: Wrap it up, please.
phrases.focus: wrap up = 包起来，餐厅常用

notes: wrap 的 w 不发音

phrases.en: Can I leave this out overnight?
phrases.focus: leave out = 放在外面，食物保存常问
variants: Is it okay to leave it out?
phrases.avoid: Can I put it outside one night?

phrases.en: I'll take the leftovers to go.
phrases.focus: leftovers = 剩菜，to go 收尾
variants: Could I take the leftovers home?

phrases.en: This is spot on.
phrases.focus: spot on = 完全到位，夸菜最地道

phrases.en: It's a little bland.
phrases.focus: bland = 没味道，比 not salty 准确

phrases.en: It's way too salty.
phrases.focus: way too = 太…了，口语加强

phrases.en: What's in this? It's amazing.
phrases.zh: 这里面有什么？太好吃了。
phrases.focus: 先问配料再夸，餐厅聊天自然
variants: This is amazing — what's in it?

phrases.en: I could eat this every day.
phrases.focus: could eat this every day = 夸张式夸奖

phrases.en: Where's the ATM?

notes: ATM 逐字母读 /ˌeɪ ti ˈɛm/

variants: Is there an ATM around here?

phrases.en: Do you sell phone chargers?
phrases.focus: sell + 商品 = 卖不卖，便利店高频

phrases.en: Can I get cash back?
phrases.focus: cash back = 结账时取现，超市常见

phrases.en: Is the restroom for customers only?
phrases.focus: for customers only = 仅限顾客
variants: Do I need to buy something to use it?

phrases.en: I'll grab a snack and go.
phrases.focus: grab = 随手拿，比 buy 轻快

phrases.en: Which aisle is the milk in?
phrases.focus: aisle 的 s 不发音，超市问货必用
variants: What aisle is the milk on?

phrases.en: Do you have any in stock?
phrases.focus: in stock = 有货，out of stock 是缺货

phrases.en: Is this the only brand you carry?
phrases.focus: carry = 进货卖，问品牌选择

pronunciation.ipa: /ɪz ðɪs ði ˈoʊnli brænd ju ˈkæri/

phrases.transfer: Is this the only ___ you carry?

phrases.en: Where can I find frozen food?
phrases.focus: frozen food = 冷冻食品，找货句式

phrases.en: Can you check in the back?
phrases.focus: check in the back = 查后仓，缺货必问

phrases.en: Is this line for self-checkout?
phrases.focus: self-checkout = 自助收银，排错队很尴尬

phrases.en: Are you in line?
phrases.focus: 确认是否排队，避免插队误会

phrases.en: Sorry, I was next.
phrases.focus: was next = 我排在前，礼貌纠正

phrases.en: Do you need a bag?
phrases.focus: 收银员高频问句，听懂秒回

phrases.en: Let me grab my wallet.
phrases.focus: let me = 让我，动作前的缓冲句

phrases.en: I'd like to return this.
phrases.focus: I'd like to = 我想，最礼貌的办事开头

phrases.en: I don't have the receipt.
It stopped working after two days.
phrases.focus: stopped working = 坏了，描述故障
phrases.avoid: It is bad after two day.

phrases.en: Can I exchange it for a different size?
phrases.focus: exchange A for B = 换货，比 change 准确

pronunciation.ipa: /kən aɪ ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ɪt fər ə ˈdɪfrənt saɪz/

variants: Could I swap it for another size?

phrases.en: Could I get store credit?
phrases.focus: store credit = 店内余额，没小票时常给
variants: Can I get store credit instead?

phrases.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
phrases.focus: how do I get to = 怎么去，问路万能

pronunciation.ipa: /ɪkˈskjuz mi haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt tə ðə ˈsteɪʃən/

phrases.en: Is it within walking distance?
phrases.focus: within walking distance = 步行可达

phrases.en: Which way is downtown?
phrases.focus: which way is = 往哪边，方向问句

phrases.en: Am I going the right way?
phrases.focus: 半路确认方向，避免越走越远

phrases.en: Could you show me on the map?
phrases.zh: 能在地图上指给我看吗？
phrases.focus: show me on the map，比描述更可靠

pronunciation.ipa: /kʊd ju ʃoʊ mi ɑn ðə mæp/

variants: Can you point it out on the map?

phrases.en: Are you free?
phrases.focus: 打车先问空不空，纽约常用

phrases.en: How long is the ride?
phrases.focus: the ride = 这趟车程，问时间

phrases.en: Can you drop me off here?
phrases.focus: drop off = 让人下车，打车必会
variants: Could you let me out here?

phrases.en: Could you wait a minute?
phrases.focus: wait a minute = 稍等，司机常听
variants: Can you hang on a second?

phrases.en: How much is it to the airport?
phrases.focus: to + 地点 = 到某地，问价

pronunciation.ipa: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ɪt tə ði ˈɛrpɔrt/

variants: What's the fare to the airport?

phrases.en: Does this bus go downtown?
phrases.focus: Does this bus go + 地点，公交必问

phrases.en: Which line goes to Brooklyn?
variants: What line do I take for Brooklyn?

phrases.en: Do I need to transfer?
phrases.context: 路线不确定要不要换线
